answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 2999 Country: SG Title: I want to know know about IT job n bank which involves dafinately pure computer work. I am a database administrator and i have a job offer n bank. in IT, database administrator is just like saving the information/data of all the transaction of the bank ans keep this data/information secure. Is this job permissible? Question: Asslam-u-Alaikum I want to know know about IT job n bank which involves dafinately pure computer work. I am a database administrator and i have a job offer n bank. in IT, database administrator is just like saving the information/data of all the transaction of the bank ans keep this data/information secure. Is this job permissible? Allah Hafiz Answer ID: 2999 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 230/208=B) If you have to write the interest accounts and transactions then this work is unlawful. In Hadith those have been cursed who feed interest, eat interest or write accounts of interest. Therefore, it must be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
